exercises.instruction: Fill the gaps in these sentences.
items: 1 Domestic animals such as dogs and cats that live with people are known as ...................... .
2 Lions and gorillas, on the other hand, are examples of ...................... animals, although you can see them in captivity in a ...................... .
3 A young sheep is called a ...................... .
5 The definition of an ...................... is a small creature with six legs and sometimes wings.
6 ...................... are the largest creatures in the sea. They are not fish, but mammals.
7 ...................... are common farm birds used for eggs and their meat.
